polityNote: Territory of the NE SDS atoms (South Sudan, ISO SSD; NE adm0_a3 SDS). Part of the Republic of the Sudan until 2011-07-09 (much of it SPLA-held during 1991–2005), Republic of South Sudan since. Abyei and Kafia Kingi are not in these atoms (NE puts both in SDN).
